text:
marta (community): Heads-up: new community rollout today — Maintainers rotation doc, Contributor Guidelines v2, and a weekend L10N sprint. Details + sign-up: https://rwd.co/l10n-sprint :tada; please RT to maintainers.
sarah (eng-oss): link to the rotation doc?
marta (community): https://github.com/redwood-inference/community/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#rotation — streamlined handover checklist and less frequent windows. Read before volunteering.
leila (i18n): We published an i18n playbook and a small TM export so translators can reuse strings. https://rwd.co/i18n-playbook
ryan (product): Any incentives for contributors during the sprint?
marta (community): Yes — small grant pool, sticker packs, and priority reviews for qualifying PRs. Winners showcased in the community newsletter.
daniel (maintainer): I'll lead the first rotation (May 4-17) and run an async onboarding hour on May 6 16:00 UTC.
leila (i18n): Can we add an APAC-friendly slot? Volunteers span timezones.
marta (community): Added May 7 02:00 UTC slot; both will be recorded.
sarah (eng-oss): Does Guidelines v2 include a PR readiness checklist?
marta (community): Yes — highlights: CI + lint requirements, i18n-ready strings, changelog entry. Snippet: - Add changelog entry under /CHANGELOG.md; - Run `yarn test` and `yarn lint:docs`; - Mark PR with `i18n-needed` if user-facing text changed.
dev-bot: Event created: "L10N Sprint" (2026-05-08 00:00 UTC -> 2026-05-09 23:59 UTC). Calendar invite sent to #community.
leila (i18n): We'll produce starter tasks (translation pairs, UI strings, README localization) and reviewer quick guides.
ryan (product): I'll coordinate priority triage for partner-related work.
marta (community): Mentors: add GitHub handle to https://rwd.co/l10n-vols by Apr 30.
sarah (eng-oss): Signed up.
daniel (maintainer): I'll add a `good-first-l10n` label and starter issue template.
marta (community): Note: Contributor Guidelines v2 is effective immediately; please submit PRs for policy edits. We'll host an AMA after the sprint. :sparkles:
